woman.prompt:
Reference handling: the attached photos are a PHOTOGRAPHIC IDENTITY reference of the young woman — keep that exact person's face, age, bone structure, long dark slightly wavy hair, and costume (oversized heather-grey cotton t-shirt, dark grey lounge shorts, bare feet, a smartphone). Ignore the bedroom lighting; render on a neutral cyclorama.

Character: Korean woman, mid-twenties, soft oval face, warm dark-brown eyes, natural no-makeup night skin, expressive — her face carries the whole story (anxious hope, doubt, sudden relief, laughter). Ordinary and believable, not a model.

PHOTOREALISTIC reference sheet arranged as a clean MULTI-PANEL grid, 16:9 horizontal, shot on a real camera with film grain — NOT illustration, NOT 3D render, no beauty filter, no glossy AI skin. NO text, NO labels, NO arrows, NO watermark, NO extra characters. Panels for the SAME character: bust portrait (large, three-quarter, neutral-hopeful expression, lips slightly parted), front full-body standing, three-quarter full-body, side profile, back, lying on her back holding the phone above her face, sitting up cross-legged hugging her knees, three expression close-ups in a row: worried-doubtful / eyes-closed relief with a suppressed smile / open laugh, hand holding the phone close-up. Keep face, hair, costume IDENTICAL in every panel. The bust/face portrait panel must occupy 25-30% of the whole sheet and be slightly OFF-FRONTAL (three-quarter). Eyes: iris color clearly readable, never crushed to black, with a visible catchlight in both eyes. Naturally asymmetric, never mirrored. PLAIN seamless light gray (#d2d2d2) studio cyclorama, soft even studio light, no rim light, no colored light.
